description.value: Sana'aih Market is a full-service community grocery store located on Nakazdli Whuten territory along Highway 27 in Fort St. James, BC, operating as part of the AGfoods buying group. It bills itself as a hospitality-based grocer focused on high-quality customer service, with dedicated departments for produce, meat, and bakery/deli. For touring cyclists passing through the Cariboo-Central Interior, it is a key resupply point in an otherwise remote stretch of the province.
